objective: Speak with Zando'zan at the Cleft of Shadow.

description: Your determination alone is not enough to overcome the obstacles that lay ahead of us.
Speak with Zando'zan to begin your training as an operative of the Shattered Hand.
It is only when you have mastered the practices of stealth and thievery that you may take the next step towards your destiny.
completion: Perhaps Zando'zan was wrong. Zando'zan apologizes.
